_doc: Curated intent taxonomy. Written by src/taxonomy.py finalize from artifacts/taxonomy/curation.json.

intents.name: Flight disruption
intents.definition: The customer wants information, rebooking or help because a flight is delayed, cancelled or diverted, or a connection is missed.
intents.boundary_notes: Happening now or about to happen. Money for a past disruption, or chasing a claim about one, is Refunds, claims & case follow-up.

intents.name: Baggage & lost property
intents.definition: The customer wants a bag or item found, delivered or explained: delayed, lost or damaged bags, allowances and fees, or something left on a plane or in a lounge.
intents.boundary_notes: Anything mainly about a bag stays here, including bag fees. Chasing an old baggage claim with customer relations is Refunds, claims & case follow-up.

intents.name: Booking, seats & upgrades
intents.definition: The customer wants their own booking changed, cancelled, corrected or added to: dates, names, seats, upgrades, special requests or assistance.
intents.boundary_notes: About their own booking. If the website or app is what's failing, it is Website, app & online check-in. General questions not about their booking are Travel information.

intents.name: Website, app & online check-in
intents.definition: The customer wants BA to fix or explain a problem using the website, app or online check-in.
intents.boundary_notes: The channel itself is failing (errors, crashes, can't log in). If they only want a booking change, it is Booking.

intents.name: Executive Club & Avios
intents.definition: The customer wants help with Avios, tier points, reward flights or their Executive Club account.
intents.boundary_notes: Reward-flight bookings belong here even when they involve changing a booking.

intents.name: Refunds, claims & case follow-up
intents.definition: The customer wants money back or compensation, or wants an existing complaint, claim or refund moved forward.
intents.boundary_notes: Includes chasing anything already submitted to customer relations, whatever the original topic. 'Please reply to my DM' with no problem stated is Contact & DM logistics.

intents.name: Contact & DM logistics
intents.definition: The customer wants to reach BA or keep a conversation going: follow or DM requests, contact numbers, confirming details were sent, asking for a reply.
intents.boundary_notes: Only when the message is about the channel itself. If it also states the problem, label the problem.

intents.name: Travel information
intents.definition: The customer wants an answer to a general question: policies, routes and schedules, lounges, onboard facilities, travel documents.
intents.boundary_notes: Not about their own booking (that is Booking) and not a complaint (that is Service complaint).

intents.name: Service complaint
intents.definition: The customer is complaining about their experience (crew, aircraft, food, lounge, a delay that is over) and wants it heard, with no more specific request.
intents.boundary_notes: A specific request always wins: 'awful flight, and where is my bag?' is Baggage.

intents.name: Other / non-actionable
intents.definition: Nothing to fix or answer: praise, thanks, banter, social posts, off-topic messages.
intents.boundary_notes: Positive or neutral with no request. A negative experience with no request is Service complaint.
